name: remote-config
title: Remote switches
summary: `GET /app-config` flags read through `slots.useFlag(key, fallback)` with a documented fallback, cached for offline launches — hide a feature or a payment channel without a release.
when: Anything the owner may need to switch off between releases: a feature under review, a payment channel per platform, a kill switch.
claudeRules: Feature switches are `slots.useFlag('key', fallback)`; only a real boolean from `GET /app-config` overrides the fallback. Document each key and its fallback where it is read.
